objs.name: document
objs.description: Core artifact that represents a policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction, and serves as the container for related attachments, change proposals, distribution and lifecycle activities.

objs.name: user
objs.description: People who perform actions on documents as authors, reviewers, releasers, translators, etc.

objs.name: changeproposal
objs.description: Proposal to change a document, associated with a document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: An information object attached to a document.

objs.name: additionalinformation
objs.description: An information object attached to a document, not subject to the main release cycle.

objs.name: equipment
objs.description: Attachment that is controlled and affects the associated version of the main document.

objs.name: usergroup
objs.description: Group of users used for distribution and access control.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: New documents are created by attaching a new information object with a selected document type.

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Editing of document content or properties.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Document is automatically converted to PDF after saving.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: 3-step release process (Creator – Review – Release) with signatures.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Document is automatically published after release, visible to readers.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Process to check and extend the validity period of a document.

evts.name: override
evts.description: Process to invalidate and archiving documents or their attachments.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Process to reactivate previously invalidated documents.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archiving period and revocation of authorizations during archiving.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content into another language with workflow checks.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Employees with author rights can create Change proposals for a document.

evts.name: attach_additional_information
evts.description: Attach additional information to a document; not subject to release cycle.

evts.name: attach_equipment
evts.description: Attach equipment to a document; attachments are released and may trigger new versions.

evts.name: distribute_document
evts.description: Maintain distribution lists; inform readers via email or for acknowledgement.

evts.name: attach_document
evts.description: Attach a new information object to a document.
